messages.content:
You are the referee of a simulated phone call between a CALLER and a customer-service AGENT.
For each numbered condition, decide whether it is met RIGHT NOW, judging mainly the agent's LATEST turn in light of the whole call.
- "the agent first ..." / "the first time ..." means it happens in the latest turn and had not happened before.
- Conditions about what the agent says are judged on its words. "[system actions: ...]" lists tools the agent used; use them only for conditions about what the agent does (e.g. "starts looking up").
- Conditions phrased as a caller stop rule (e.g. "Agent confirms ...", "End the call right after ...") are met when the call has reached that point.
- A condition about how the agent responds to something (symptoms, a 911 instruction, a correction) is NOT met unless that thing has already happened in the call.
- Be literal and strict: if in doubt, it is not met.
Reply with JSON only, one key per condition id: {"<id>": {"met": true|false, "why": "<at most 15 words>"}}

CALL SO FAR:
CALLER: Hi, calling for my mother, Irene Kowalski. I want to move her sertraline and her donepezil to the Brightway on Route 9.
AGENT: Hi there! I'd be happy to help move your mom's medications. Let me start by verifying her information. What's Irene Kowalski's date of birth?
CALLER: March 3rd, 1942. I'm her son Walt, I'm on the account.
AGENT: Thanks Walt. Let me verify that information and check her prescriptions. Great, Walt. I found the Brightway on Route 9 in Brookfield. I can move the sertraline and donepezil there for you. I also see your mom has a lorazepam prescription at our store—do you want to move that one too, or just the two you mentioned?  [system actions: verify_identity, list_prescriptions, find_stores]
CALLER: Wait, not Route 9, the one on Elm by the FreshMart. And yeah, move the lorazepam too, the anxiety one.
AGENT (LATEST): Got it, let me find the Brightway on Elm by the FreshMart. Perfect, I found it—Brightway Drug on Elm Street by the FreshMart. Now, the sertraline and donepezil are non-controlled, so those will transfer right over. But the lorazepam is a controlled medication, so I need to have our pharmacist confirm with Brightway that they can take it before I send it. I'll flag that for our pharmacist to handle. Does that work?  [system actions: find_stores]

CONDITIONS:
move_1: the agent confirms the Elm St store or its address
move_2: the agent says the lorazepam goes to a pharmacist or is pending
disclosure_3: after the agent confirms the Elm St store
stop_0: Agent explains that the Brightway on Elm St must call Harbor to request the transfer (including the lorazepam), and recaps what Walt needs to do.
emergency: In its LATEST turn, the agent told the caller to hang up and call 911 (or emergency services) now.

JSON only.

message.content: {"move_1": {"met": true, "why": "Agent confirmed Brightway Drug on Elm Street by FreshMart."}, "move_2": {"met": true, "why": "Agent says lorazepam will be flagged for pharmacist confirmation."}, "disclosure_3": {"met": true, "why": "Elm St store was just confirmed in this turn."}, "stop_0": {"met": false, "why": "No mention of Elm St calling Harbor to request transfer."}, "emergency": {"met": false, "why": "No mention of 911 or emergency services."}}
